tldr: Jupiter in the 10th house: growth becomes personal through career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction.
body:
With Jupiter in the 10th house, this part of you expands through career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction. Jupiter describes growth, faith, appetite, opportunity, generosity, and the need for a wider view. In practice, this brings attention to the work, responsibilities, goals, and public roles that shape how you are seen.

When this placement is supported, your direction can become more visible, accountable, and real. Jupiter can become hope, confidence, perspective, generosity, and a larger sense of possibility.

When it is strained, achievement or approval can start carrying too much of your identity. The harder pattern can show up as overextension, excess, overpromising, or assuming more is always better.
gift: hope, confidence, perspective, generosity, and a larger sense of possibility expressed through career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction.
challenge: overextension, excess, overpromising, or assuming more is always better around career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction.
